user.title: Tigo account
user.description: Credentials of the Tigo account (the same used on ei.tigoenergy.com). Only today's reclaimed energy is read.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Tigo cloud. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.no_systems: No system found on this account.

abort.endpoint_unauthorized: Login works, but Tigo refuses the reclaimed-energy data for this account.
abort.cannot_read: Login works, but the reclaimed-energy data could not be read. Check the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: How often Tigo is asked for today's reclaimed energy. The value always refers to the current calendar day: with long intervals it is read only a few times a day.
